LanguageData.OPN_SettingsIntro: Open a save to edit the naming rule and check each prisoner's alias.
LanguageData.OPN_NoGame: Enter a save to open the editor.
LanguageData.OPN_GameChanged: This save is no longer active. Close the window and open it again.
LanguageData.OPN_Applied: Rule applied. Names refresh from the prisoners' current condition.
LanguageData.OPN_KeepActive: The draft was not applied. The previous rule is still in use.
LanguageData.OPN_Restored: Draft restored from the applied rule.
LanguageData.OPN_DefaultLoaded: Default draft loaded. Apply it to use these names.
LanguageData.OPN_NoPrisoners: No colony prisoners. Capture someone, then refresh.
LanguageData.OPN_NoSelection: Select a prisoner to set an individual alias.
LanguageData.OPN_ManualSet: Individual alias set. It stays until cleared.
LanguageData.OPN_ManualCleared: Individual alias cleared. The rule is used again.
LanguageData.OPN_Help: Write fn codename(pawn). Return an alias, or null or blank to show the original name. Useful values: number_text (001), original_name, race, age, interaction, resistance, score, grade. pawn.value("mark", 0) reads a stored value. Apply activates the draft. Restore and defaults only edit the draft. Rules, scores, grades, stored values and individual aliases are saved with the game.
LanguageData.OPN_PolicyIntro: Set the score, grades, race prefixes and name pattern for this save. Advanced rules open in the browser editor.
LanguageData.OPN_UsePatternConfirm: Replace this save's custom naming rule and naming draft with the current pattern? Event rules and individual overrides remain unchanged.
LanguageData.OPN_PolicyFailed: The name policy was not saved.
LanguageData.OPN_ScoreAutomatic: Event scoring resumed; current score retained.
LanguageData.OPN_OpenEditorConfirm: Open the browser editor for this save?
LanguageData.OPN_BrowserEditing: Advanced naming and event rules open in the browser editor.
LanguageData.OPN_CustodyScore: Score for each full day in custody
LanguageData.OPN_ScoreSet: Score set. Events will not change it.
LanguageData.OPN_GradeSet: Grade set. The score stays unchanged.
